content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-315. - Procedure for adjudicating violations.
content.summary:
The provisions of
section 2-171
et seq. "Administrative Hearings" shall govern the procedure for adjudication of
               alleged violations of this article.
(Code 1981, § 27-224; Ord. No. 3717, § 1, 8-27-2001)
